Definition: from G1537 and a compound of G1223 and G2233; to narrate through wholly:--declare.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to narrate through, to tell a story all the way to the end, and Luke uses it twice. Paul quotes the prophet, warning the despisers who will wonder and perish at the work God is doing, and the church at Jerusalem hears Paul and Barnabas declare all the things God has done with the Gentiles. The word is for stories that must be told in full.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's works must be told all the way through, because a half-told story hides the very part where He acted.
